skill.name: ai-image-generation
skill.description: Generate and edit AI images through the inference.sh belt CLI using FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, Reve, and related models.
skill.summary: Use inference.sh image models for text-to-image, image editing, upscaling, and image composition workflows.
skill.author: infsh-skills

security_audit.summary: Most backtick detections are markdown formatting or model identifiers, but the skill does intentionally run belt CLI commands and reference remote image services. No evidence found of prompt injection or malicious credential exfiltration in SKILL.md. The main risks are expected remote-service data disclosure and related-skill installation commands.

remediation.suggestion: Keep the allowed tool scope limited to belt commands and avoid shell composition with unsanitized user input. Document that prompts and image URLs go to remote services.
Move optional npx skills add commands behind a clear review warning. Tell users that each related skill needs separate security review before installation.

remediation.issue: Remote markdown asset and documentation links
remediation.suggestion: Use marketplace-hosted images when possible and verify external documentation links before publication. Avoid remote assets that are not needed for skill operation.

content.value_statement: Teams need consistent prompts and model choices for AI image work. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code practical guidance for inference.sh image generation.
actual_capabilities: Provides belt CLI examples for text-to-image generation with FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, and Reve models.
Shows how to browse available image apps by category through inference.sh.
Includes examples for product photos, landscapes, posters with text, portraits, and stylized scenes.
Documents image upscaling with Topaz through the inference.sh app catalog.
Shows a multi-image stitching workflow using image URLs.
Lists related skills for platform, FLUX, upscaling, background removal, video, and avatar workflows.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh belt CLI and an authenticated account.
Uses remote model services, so prompts and image URLs may leave the local environment.
Costs, model availability, and output quality depend on inference.sh and provider settings.
Does not provide local image generation, safety filtering, or rights clearance.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate draft social posts, product scenes, and brand concept images with named image models.

use_cases.title: Explore Product Mockups
use_cases.description: Turn product ideas into studio-style image prompts and compare fast or high-quality model options.

use_cases.title: Prepare Visual Assets
use_cases.description: Upscale images, stitch references, and create poster concepts through inference.sh image apps.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Simple Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a studio product image of a ceramic mug. Choose a reliable model and explain the command before running it.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Model Options
prompt_templates.scenario: Choose a model for a visual direction
prompt_templates.prompt: I need a cinematic landscape image. Compare FLUX, Gemini, Grok, and Seedream options, then recommend one model for quality and speed.

prompt_templates.title: Edit and Upscale an Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan an image edit and upscale workflow for a product photo. Ask for the image URL before running any command.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Visual Production Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a three-step workflow for campaign visuals: generate concepts, select the best model, and prepare final images for review.

output_examples.input: Create a product image for a reusable water bottle on a clean studio background.
output_examples.output: Recommended FLUX for a polished product mockup. The result should be a clean studio image with soft shadows and clear bottle details.

output_examples.input: Make a poster concept with readable headline text.
output_examples.output: Recommended Reve because the skill notes natural language editing and text rendering. The output should prioritize legible headline placement.

output_examples.input: Improve a low-resolution reference image for a presentation.
output_examples.output: Recommended the Topaz upscaler app. Provide the image URL only after confirming the remote service data boundary.

best_practices: Confirm that prompts and image URLs can be sent to remote inference services before running commands.
Choose the model based on the needed balance of quality, speed, text rendering, and cost.
Review generated images for brand fit, rights concerns, and sensitive content before use.
anti_patterns: Do not send private images, confidential product data, or unreleased campaign details without approval.
Do not install related skills automatically without reviewing their separate instructions and permissions.
Do not assume every model supports the same aspect ratios, editing features, or text rendering quality.

faq.question: What does this skill use to generate images?
faq.answer: It uses the inference.sh belt CLI to run hosted image apps such as FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, and Reve.

faq.question: Does it work without network access?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflows use remote inference.sh services and require the belt CLI.

faq.question: Can it edit existing images?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes image editing, upscaling, and stitching examples that use remote image URLs.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should users check before running commands?
faq.answer: Users should confirm authentication, expected cost, data sharing rules, and the selected model parameters.

faq.question: Are the related skills part of this audit?
faq.answer: No. Related skill installation commands point to other packages that need separate review before use.
